plate:e2-pruefung.desc: Dusk in a rebel camp in a forest clearing, canvas tents and a small campfire, deep blue-violet evening sky. In the centre Lia (the slender 16-year-old girl with strawberry-blonde curls and the long moss-green cloak from the first attached reference sheet) kneels on the ground; two ordinary human rebel guards (brown padded gambesons, sleeveless tabards in dark red and white, open nasal helmets), seen mostly FROM BEHIND, stand at her sides and grip her upper arms. A sudden burst of bright TURQUOISE light erupts from Lia in a ring around her, her eyes glow bright blue-turquoise. To the left Elnon (the tall black-haired elf with a long braid and the embroidered green tunic from the second sheet) recoils a step, raising his forearm against the glare. To the right the old druid (grey braids with wooden beads, grey-green robe, leather mantle, from the third sheet) holds an EMPTY wooden bowl, startled. Full figures, nobody cut off at the head. No blood, no weapons drawn.

plate:e2-sehkugel.desc: Close-up in a dark stone chamber lit only by the object: a hand-sized clear crystal orb resting on a small black wrought-iron stand on a dark wooden table. From the top of the frame a long wide BLACK sleeve reaches in, only the pale, bony, long fingertips of a hand visible, hovering just above the orb without touching it (no face, no body, no other person). Deep inside the orb glows one TINY TURQUOISE spark. Cold violet reflections and highlights play on the crystal surface, the iron stand and the fingertips. Rough grey stone wall in deep shadow behind. Ominous, quiet mood. Anatomically correct hand: thin fingers, at most five.

plate:e2-trennung.desc: Pre-dawn in a rebel forest camp: deep blue sky just beginning to pale above the dark trees; the scene is lit warmly by a few torches on poles and one small campfire burning calmly inside a ring of stones. The camp is INTACT: plain canvas tents stand undamaged in the background. NO burning tents, NO spreading fire, no flames on anything except the torches and the campfire, no smoke clouds, no destruction, no bodies on the ground. Behind the figures runs a tall wooden palisade of sharpened upright logs. Sitting on the ground with their backs against the palisade, side by side, captive: Flick (the half-elf girl with short messy almost-black hair with one pale streak, pointed ears, olive-green hooded coat, iron shackles with a short chain on her wrists, from the second sheet) and Elnon (the elf man with long black hair in a braid and the green tunic with golden-orange leaf embroidery from the third sheet, without his axe, his wrists tied with rope). From the left, one hooded henchman of the dark army (black cloth hood pulled over his head, face in shadow, sleeveless knee-length tabard quartered in plain BLACK and WHITE over chain mail like the fifth sheet, but a black hood instead of a helmet, no emblem) drags Kyra in by the upper arm: the 16-year-old girl from the first sheet with long wavy nut-brown hair falling loose over her shoulders exactly as on that sheet, plain beige dress, wrists tied with rope; she stumbles and resists. On the right stands Baris (the HUGE bearded man in near-black plate armour with dark red straps from the fourth sheet; the RIGHT half of his face is a red mottled burn scar with a milky blind right eye), axe lowered, his head turned down, looking at the seated Flick with grim recognition. Full figures, nobody cut off at the head. No blood, no wounds.

plate:e2-bericht-xenovia.desc: A single flat sheet of pale peeled BIRCH BARK (white-cream with dark horizontal lenticel marks, curled slightly at the edges) lies on a mossy forest floor among a few fallen autumn leaves and twigs, seen from directly above, filling most of the image. On the bark a rough hand-drawn sketch in black CHARCOAL with a little brown-yellow OCHRE wash: in the middle a huge fallen goddess figure with long flowing hair, drawn in simple lines, half sinking into stylised curled WAVES; around her TEN small simple human stick-like figures with raised arms. To one side a simple drawn mountain with a cave whose mouth is sealed by a big stone, a small light glowing inside the cave. The ONLY colour in the drawing is that small cave light, coloured TURQUOISE; everything else on the bark is charcoal black and ochre. No writing, no letters, no runes on the bark.

plate:e2-erinnerung.desc: A painful MEMORY image, the whole picture framed by a soft, misty COLD VIOLET vignette that fades the edges. In the middle ground a row of kneeling prisoners in dark SILHOUETTE, heads bowed, and a few armed standing silhouettes with spears and helmets behind them, all small and featureless against the firelight. Sad, quiet, dreamlike. No gore, no blood, no execution shown, no faces.

plate:e2-schattentoeter.desc: Early morning in a hermit's camp in a forest clearing: a lean-to shelter under an old beech tree, a smoking campfire, a woodpile, mist and soft golden morning light through the trees. The old hermit Ignatius (bald crown, long untrimmed white beard, faded patched rust-orange robe under a brown forest cloak, from the first sheet) solemnly holds out with both hands a long natural wooden STAFF with knots and a leather grip wrapping. Lia (the slender 16-year-old girl with strawberry-blonde curls, moss-green cloak thrown back over her shoulders, from the second sheet) stands facing him and reaches out with one hand to take the staff. The staff is the clear focus between them. Both full figures, three-quarter view, nobody cut off at the head. No magic glow.

plate:e2-kontrolle.desc: A vaulted stone dungeon hall lit by a single iron brazier, cold shadows. Before her Elnon (the tall black-haired elf with a long braid and green tunic, from the second sheet, tunic torn, bruised) kneels on the floor with iron chains on his wrists, looking up at her. Directly behind Kyra stands the tall black-hooded figure of Vamir (from the third sheet), his face COMPLETELY hidden in the black shadow of the hood, one pale bony hand resting on Kyra's shoulder, faint cold violet wisps around him. Tense and quiet. Full figures, nobody cut off at the head. No blood, no wounds shown, the sword does not touch anyone.

plate:e2-flucht.desc: A dim dungeon corridor with barred cells, a lantern on a guard table, torchlight. On the stone floor at her feet lie OPENED iron manacles with a short chain. Inside the cell behind her Elnon (the tall black-haired elf with a long braid, green tunic, from the second sheet, tunic torn) sits on the floor against the barred wall, waving her to go with one hand; beside him Kyra (long nut-brown hair, beige dress, from the third sheet) lies unconscious on a bit of straw, eyes closed, peaceful. Full figures, nobody cut off at the head. No blood.

Forked bolts of COLD VIOLET lightning crackle out from his raised hands and fork across the clear sky. Low camera from the slope, the full figure visible from hood to hem, not cut off. Background: wild rolling hills covered in dense forest, one calm lake far below, distant blue hills in haze. plate:e3-flick-kopfueber.desc: A light-hearted COMEDY scene in a small forest clearing at dusk (blue-violet evening sky between the trees, warm orange firelight). On the RIGHT a big old oak with one thick low branch. From the branch Flick (first sheet: slender half-elf woman, short messy almost-black hair with one pale streak, pointed ears, freckles, dusty olive-green coat, iron manacles on her wrists) dangles UPSIDE DOWN, caught by both boots in a goblin snare rope tied to the branch — a classic cartoon trap gag; she is unhurt and simply bored: arms folded over her chest, rolling her eyes with a dry, sarcastic, unimpressed look, her short hair falling down. Below her and to the LEFT, around a small campfire in a ring of stones with a big dented iron cooking pot hanging over it, the three small comic goblins squabble about the pot: Ratz (second sheet: skinny, dented pot as a helmet, ragged purple cape) points his big wooden spoon like a sceptre and gives pompous orders; fat Hotze (third sheet: round belly, greasy cook's apron, floppy ears) clutches the pot handle and his roasting spit with a sausage, licking his lips; tiny Fips (fourth sheet: huge nose, feathers in his hair, slingshot in his belt) tugs at the other side of the pot, arguing loudly. Funny body language, cosy evening light, fireflies, no blood, no injury, nothing scary. Flick and all three goblins fully visible, nobody cut off. Anatomically correct hands.

plate:e3-flick-versteinert.desc: A false rebel camp in a forest clearing on a grey, overcast morning: empty white canvas tents, a sharpened wooden palisade, a black-and-white quartered banner, a smoking campfire nobody tends; in the BACKGROUND a heavy wooden CAGE WAGON with iron bars, its brown tarp half pulled off. On the LEFT stands Vamir (third sheet: tall figure in a long black hooded robe, the face completely hidden in black shadow inside the hood, black smoke curling from the hem), his RIGHT arm stretched out toward the right, pale bony fingers spread, and a crackling beam of cold VIOLET magic shoots from his hand (violet and black only, no turquoise). The beam hits Flick (first sheet: slender half-elf woman, short messy almost-black hair with one pale streak, pointed ears, olive-green hunter's coat, quiver on her back) in the middle of a furious attacking LEAP toward him with her hunting knife drawn in her RIGHT hand, a fierce determined face — and she is turning into grey STONE right there in mid-air: most of her body is already solid grey granite with thin glowing violet cracks (like the second sheet), only a few last patches of colour at her hair and coat are being swallowed by the creeping grey stone. Dramatic, cold violet light against the grey morning, a few stone flakes and violet sparks in the air. No blood. Both figures fully visible, nobody cut off. Anatomically correct hands.
